whatWasTested: The step-5 coverage repair enabled through PI_COVERAGE_REPAIR=1, forwarded into the disposable container, on the weak generator at the same configuration as the earlier weak arms.

landing.feature: planHarnessConsolidationPhase gained coverageRepair; on an empty plan with a screened constraint it re-asks once through repairHarnessPlan with allowOmissions: false, and adopts the result only when coverageRepairAccepted(validationErrors, operationCount) holds, so a failed repair keeps the previous plan.
landing.defaultOff: The parent enables it only when the harness policy applies, the screen found constraint evidence, and PI_COVERAGE_REPAIR === 1. Three existing tests encode the reviewed-verdict and harness-only-evidence contracts, and enabling it by default broke all three, so opt-in is the correct gate.
tests: wiring and ordering test, including that the switch sits outside the Jev-only spread
landing.verification: 1100 passed in 359.50 s; typecheck exit 0; pack:check exit 0 with 19 manifests; dry pack ok; diff check exit 0.

verdict.result: inconclusive for the coverage repair, because the weak generator produced no valid plan at all this run, so neither the Memory nor the Harness path had material for a repair to work on.
verdict.targetsUnmet: The pre-registered weak-generator on-arm targets remain unproven: Memory operations with privatePreference and safeFact passing, and enforcement blocking. They are not disproven either.
verdict.rootCauseOfTheNoise: The weak generator's failure stage varies run to run. Across five weak runs it produced: a bounds refusal with a small degenerate plan; an applied plan with two items but the command fact missing; a structurally rejected plan twice; and now a rejected plan with no valid candidate at all.

theOnlyWayToAttribute: Hold the plan fixed. Five runs per arm would average over plans but still could not attribute a per-run difference to the judge; the plan-injection seam is what makes attribution possible, and it does not exist yet.
limits: One project, one generator, one run with the switch on; the generator's variance dominates the outcome.
The coverage repair itself was not exercised in this run, because the plan was empty for a different reason: no valid candidate was produced at all.
No finished arm was rerun; this was a new configuration with a new digest.
